title: Lemon Garlic Pasta
description: Bright lemon, garlic and Parmesan coat spaghetti in this easy stovetop favorite.
instructions: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti according to package directions; reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Gently cook garlic in olive oil over medium-low heat for 1–2 minutes until fragrant, not browned.
Toss cooked pasta with garlic oil, lemon zest, juice, and a splash of pasta water.
Remove from heat, add Parmesan and parsley, and season to taste.
